function.name: execute_bash

content:
cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libucl && cat > /workspace/poc.txt <<'EOF'
a: { b: 1 }
a: { c: 2 }
EOF



cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug >/tmp/cmake.log 2>&1 && cmake --build build -j2 >/tmp/build.log 2>&1 && ./build/tests/fuzzers/ucl_add_string_fuzzer /workspace/poc.txt >/tmp/run.log 2>&1; ec=$?; echo EXIT:$ec; tail -50 /tmp/run.log
EXIT:127
tail: cannot open '/tmp/run.log' for reading: No such file or directory
